blurb: Skydive Cincinnati is a family owned and operated dropzone located in Waynesville, OH, near Cincinnati and Dayton. They offer tandem skydiving for first-timers, Accelerated Free Fall (AFF) and Static-Line training programs for solo skydiving, and welcome experienced skydivers for fun jumps. The dropzone has been operating since 1969 and is a USPA member.
extraNote: Plan to spend 4-6 hours for the entire skydiving experience · No loss of deposit if weather cancels jump, rescheduling available · No alcohol consumption during jump operations · No GoPro or wearable cameras allowed for first-time jumpers · Red Stewart Airfield in Waynesville, OH
